verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships a documented no-code/low-code Connector Builder UI (with AI Assist to prefill config) specifically designed for building custom connectors for long-tail APIs without forking the codebase, plus CDK-based frameworks referenced via docs. This directly satisfies the story. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of building a full working custom connector via the Builder for a long-tail API, and details on limitations/edge cases of the low-code builder for complex auth or pagination schemes.
